PROCEDURE CODE
1150
If the applicant is an emancipated minor, he may file the application without the assistance of his guardian.
(If the applicant is an unemancipated minor, or if he is a protected person who, pursuant to Article 492/1 of the Civil Code, has been declared incapable of disposing of property]1the application is made by his legal representative). 
If he does not have a guardian or administrator or if he is not present, the application may be made by one of his parents.
In cases of extreme urgency, an unemancipated minor may lodge the application personally.
